raw_text: DRDO targeted by supply chain APT attack through a third-party IT vendor. Custom malware hidden in a lab management software update. This is a classic supply chain compromise. Initial attribution points to a South Asian state-sponsored group. NIA investigation underway. How many other defence research orgs use the same vendor?
clean_text: Discussion of DRDO supply chain attack via compromised IT vendor. Custom malware in software update. South Asian state-sponsored group suspected. NIA investigating.
